name: Necrosex
source: A frustrated writer obtains an old spell book with which he seeks to revive his former nanny, who was the victim of a serial killer.  Desperate, he thinks it would make a great story to tell, but will she agree?
translation: 一位失意的作家得到了一本古老的咒书，打算借此复活曾遭连环杀手杀害的前保姆。绝望之下，他觉得这会是个绝佳的故事素材，但她会答应吗？
